tasks.objective: UI/UX + eng — generator and recipe lifecycle state across navigation. Two symptoms, one root cause: component-scoped state plus detached async surviving component destruction. v0.4.12 (KAN-243) moved the image-generation SPINNER into RecipeStateService but not the DATA, so the client copy still holds pending/null image metadata after nav-away — visible on single-recipe JSON export. generator.component.ts:57-74 writes only ai_image_url via updateRecipeField; the remaining image fields are written server-side by the Pub/Sub worker and never re-read. Separately, clearRecipe() fires inside onGenerate() (generator.component.ts:34) — on submit, not on route entry — so navigating TO the generator shows the previous recipe. Run the eng review on the state architecture; run the design review on what the user sees during and after nav-away. LANE B — do not touch cloudbuild* or .github/workflows/. loop.sequencing_note: T0 first. Then T1 (Lane A anchor) alone — the charter's execution order runs Lane A on day 1 before any other lane, and Adam's direction is to focus KAN-151 and the IP/middleware rate-limiting cluster first. loop.max_iterations_reason: 11 tasks x (execute + verify) is 22 iterations before a single retry; the droppables get 2 attempts and the uncapped SIs 5, so the default 12 would hit the global cap mid-sprint and escalate on arithmetic rather than on evidence. 48 leaves headroom for the retries D6 explicitly declines to cap.
